passages.text: And God spoke all these words: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
passages.sermon:
God spoke all these words.
God said these words to the people of Israel.
God said, "I am the LORD your God."
I brought you out of the land of Egypt.
I brought you out of the house of slavery.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס אָֽנֹכִ֖י֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣֥ית עֲבָדִיֽ֑ם׃

passages.text: You shall have no other gods before Me.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “I am the LORD your God.”
God brought the people out of Egypt.
God freed them from slavery.
God commanded the people.
God said, “You shall have no other gods before Me.”
passages.original: לֹֽ֣א יִהְיֶֽה־ לְךָ֛֩ אֱלֹהִ֥֨ים אֲחֵרִ֖֜ים עַל־ פָּנָֽ֗יַ׃

passages.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave them commandments.
God said, “Do not make an idol for yourself.
Do not make any image or statue.
Do not make anything that looks like what is in the heavens above.
Do not make anything that looks like what is on the earth below.
Do not make anything that looks like what is in the waters under the earth.”

passages.text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me, but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is a jealous God.
Do not bow down to idols.
Do not worship idols.
The LORD punishes the children for the sins of their fathers.
He does this to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Him.
The LORD shows loving devotion to a thousand generations.
He does this for those who love Him.
He does this for those who keep His commandments.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתַּחְוֶ֥֣ה לָהֶ֖ם֮ וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם֒ כִּ֣י אָֽנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָבֹ֧ת עַל־ בָּנִ֛ים עַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃ וְעֹ֥֤שֶׂה חֶ֖֙סֶד֙ לַאֲלָפִ֑֔ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽי׃ס

passages.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
passages.sermon: The LORD is your God.\r\nDo not use the name of the LORD your God in a worthless or disrespectful way.\r\nIf anyone uses His name in vain, the LORD will not leave that person unpunished.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃פ

passages.text: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
passages.sermon: God commands you to remember the Sabbath day.\r\nGod tells you to keep the Sabbath day holy.
passages.original: זָכ֛וֹר֩ אֶת־ י֥֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖֜ת לְקַדְּשֽׁ֗וֹ׃

passages.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to His people.
God said, "Work for six days."
Do all your work in those six days.
The seventh day is different.
The seventh day is a Sabbath.
The Sabbath belongs to the LORD your God.
Do not do any work on the Sabbath.
You must rest on this day.
Your son must not work on the Sabbath.
Your daughter must not work on the Sabbath.
Your male servant must not work on the Sabbath.
Your female servant must not work on the Sabbath.
Your livestock must not work on the Sabbath.
The foreigner who lives in your gates must not work on the Sabbath.
Everyone in your household must rest on the Sabbath.
passages.original: שֵׁ֤֣שֶׁת יָמִ֣ים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד֮ וְעָשִׂ֖֣יתָ כָּל־ מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ֒׃ וְי֙וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔֜י שַׁבָּ֖֣ת׀ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֗יךָ לֹֽ֣א־ תַעֲשֶׂ֣֨ה כָל־ מְלָאכָ֡֜ה אַתָּ֣ה׀ וּבִנְךָֽ֣־ וּ֠בִתֶּ֗ךָ עַבְדְּךָ֤֨ וַאֲמָֽתְךָ֜֙ וּבְהֶמְתֶּ֔֗ךָ וְגֵרְךָ֖֙ אֲשֶׁ֥֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽ֔יךָ׃

passages.text: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD made the heavens in six days.
The LORD made the earth in six days.
The LORD made the sea in six days.
The LORD made everything in the heavens, the earth, and the sea in six days.
On the seventh day, the LORD rested.
The LORD blessed the Sabbath day.
The LORD set the Sabbath day apart as holy.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שֵֽׁשֶׁת־ יָמִים֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ הַיָּם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖נַח בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י עַל־ כֵּ֗ן בֵּרַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת וַֽיְקַדְּשֵֽׁהוּ׃ס

passages.text: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to His people.
God is the LORD your God.
God gives you the land.
Honor your father.
Honor your mother.
If you honor your father and mother, your days will be long in the land.
God gives you this land.
passages.original: כַּבֵּ֥ד אֶת־ אָבִ֖יךָ וְאֶת־ אִמֶּ֑ךָ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יַאֲרִכ֣וּן יָמֶ֔יךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: You shall not murder.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command.
God said, "You shall not murder."
Do not kill another person.

passages.text: You shall not commit adultery.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to His people.
\r\nGod said, "You shall not commit adultery."
\r\nDo not be unfaithful to your spouse.
\r\nDo not break the marriage covenant.

passages.text: You shall not steal.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the people of Israel.
God said, “You shall not steal.”
God told the people not to take what does not belong to them.
God commanded each person to respect the property of others.
God made this rule clear to everyone.

passages.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to the people of Israel.
God told them how to live with each other.
God said, “You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.”
Do not say things about your neighbor that are not true.
Do not give a false report about your neighbor.
Do not lie about your neighbor in court or anywhere else.
Always speak the truth about others.
Do not harm your neighbor with lies.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁקֶר׃ס

passages.text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to His people.
God said, “Do not covet.”
Do not covet your neighbor’s house.
Do not covet your neighbor’s wife.
Do not covet your neighbor’s male servant.
Do not covet your neighbor’s female servant.
Do not covet your neighbor’s ox.
Do not covet your neighbor’s donkey.
Do not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֹֽא־ תַחְמֹ֞ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֗ךָ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ וְשׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃פ

passages.text: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
passages.sermon:
All the people saw the thunder.
They saw the lightning.
They heard the sound of the ram’s horn.
They saw the mountain covered in smoke.
The people saw these things.
They trembled with fear.
They stood far away.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הָעָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת־ הַקּוֹלֹ֜ת וְאֶת־ הַלַּפִּידִ֗ם וְאֵת֙ ק֣וֹל הַשֹּׁפָ֔ר וְאֶת־ הָהָ֖ר עָשֵׁ֑ן וַיַּ֤רְא הָעָם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔עוּ וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ מֵֽרָחֹֽק׃

passages.text: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to Moses.
They said, “Moses, you speak with us.
We will listen to you.
Do not let God speak with us.
If God speaks with us, we will die.”
passages.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה דַּבֵּר־ אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְנִשְׁמָ֑עָה וְאַל־ יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּ֛נוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים פֶּן־ נָמֽוּת׃

passages.text: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people.
He said, “Do not be afraid.”
God has come to test you.
God wants you to fear Him.
This fear will help you avoid sin.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־ הָעָם֮ אַל־ תִּירָאוּ֒ כִּ֗י לְבַֽעֲבוּר֙ נַסּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶ֔ם בָּ֖א הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבַעֲב֗וּר תִּהְיֶ֧ה יִרְאָת֛וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י תֶחֱטָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
passages.sermon: The people stood far away.\r\nMoses walked toward the thick darkness.\r\nGod was in the thick darkness.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד הָעָ֖ם מֵרָחֹ֑ק וּמֹשֶׁה֙ נִגַּ֣שׁ אֶל־ הָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
The LORD said, “Tell the Israelites this.”
“You have seen something important.”
You have seen that I, the LORD, spoke to you.
I spoke to you from heaven.
You saw this with your own eyes.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם כִּ֚י מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עִמָּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God said, “Do not make any gods besides Me.
Do not make gods of silver.
Do not make gods of gold.
Do not make these for yourselves.”
passages.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּן אִתִּ֑י אֱלֹ֤הֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ וֵאלֹהֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God said, "Make an altar for Me.
Build this altar from earth.
Offer your burnt offerings on this altar.
Offer your peace offerings on this altar.
Bring your sheep and goats to this altar.
Bring your cattle to this altar.
I will choose places where My name is remembered.
In every such place, I will come to you.
I will bless you there."
passages.original: מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲדָמָה֮ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לִּי֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֣ עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ עֹלֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־ שְׁלָמֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ צֹֽאנְךָ֖ וְאֶת־ בְּקָרֶ֑ךָ בְּכָל־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַזְכִּ֣יר אֶת־ שְׁמִ֔י אָב֥וֹא אֵלֶ֖יךָ וּבֵרַכְתִּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to the Israelites.
God gives instructions about building an altar.
If you make an altar of stones for God, do not use stones shaped by tools.
Do not build the altar with cut or carved stones.
If you use your tool on the stones, you make the altar unholy.
Using a chisel or sword on the stones defiles the altar.
passages.original: וְאִם־ מִזְבַּ֤ח אֲבָנִים֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לִּ֔י לֹֽא־ תִבְנֶ֥ה אֶתְהֶ֖ן גָּזִ֑ית כִּ֧י חַרְבְּךָ֛ הֵנַ֥פְתָּ עָלֶ֖יהָ וַתְּחַֽלְלֶֽהָ׃

passages.text: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God gave instructions about His altar.
God said, "Do not go up to My altar using steps."
If you use steps, your nakedness may be exposed on the altar.
God does not want your nakedness to be seen at His altar.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַעֲלֶ֥ה בְמַעֲלֹ֖ת עַֽל־ מִזְבְּחִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ תִגָּלֶ֥ה עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃פ
